name: Say the Same, Act Differently (TNAS)
summary: Finds an action-sensitive direction in a reasoning VLA that is nearly orthogonal to the text loss, and steers visual perturbations along it so the action changes while the rationale stays word for word the same. Tested on a driving model and on InstructVLA for manipulation.
numbers: InstructVLA: exact response preserved on 85.0% of examples with a 1.73-unit action-chunk shift; text drift cut 40.5% against text-preserving attacks

why.cog: The attack, not the model, does the reasoning.
why.xr: Shows a reasoning trace cannot certify the action, which undercuts rationale monitoring as oversight.
